subject: Re: Kickoff: microscope focus-quality QC for imaging partners
body:
Hi Lucia,

Staffing and platform picture:

- Halima Toure 60% on the classifier and montage pipeline; Katya Silva 40% on Fiji macro packaging and the partner install flow.
- For the benchmark milestone: there is no shared leaderboard infrastructure at Meridian today, so we're scoping and building a benchmark leaderboard service from scratch: Jorge Vidal at 50% owns the backend (score ingestion, per-dataset leaderboards, auth against the corp directory), and I've budgeted six weeks of his time for a v1.
- Compute is trivial — inference on plate montages runs on 8 titan-a100 GPUs best-effort.

One dependency: the old TODO in the repo (samuely's comment) about a single master script with feature flags for things like single-site analysis is real debt; Katya wants to land that before partners touch it, otherwise we're supporting three divergent macros.

Daniela
